stops.name: Psiloritis Natural Park
stops.detail: Psiloritis Natural Park extends on the Psiloritis mountain and its northern foothills till the Cretan Sea. It has an area of 1159 km2. Administratively the park is split into the Prefectures of Rethymno and Heraklion.  The headquarters of the park are located at the municipality of Anogeia.
